purpose: Curated process lessons from completed official-flow experiments. Entries are advisory prompt constraints only: they never provide a patch, override an assigned source boundary, change a QoR contract, or affect Controller promotion.
contribution_protocol: Add an entry only after complete official evidence identifies a reusable mechanism-level lesson.
State the observed scope and measured evidence; distinguish a source diff, telemetry activation, cell-set effect, and final QoR effect.
Provide one bounded planning rule, one Student implementation rule, and one review rule. Do not encode a design-specific patch recipe.
Keep campaign-local measurements in its EPD/observation artifacts. This library stores only the compact cross-design lesson.

lessons.title: A rejected source anchor is missing exploration coverage, not a completed experiment
lessons.evidence_summary: AES P0 R3 lost two of three planned source experiments before evaluation because one historical anchor no longer resolved and one quoted symbol was not verified. The surviving Integrator alone could not supply the intended direct-power coverage.
lessons.planning_rule: Use only live AST/source-verifiable path::symbol anchors. When Controller admission drops an Explorer, treat its mechanism family as untested and restore that coverage with a distinct verified anchor in a later plan; do not write a review as if the rejected experiment had run.
lessons.student_rule: Before editing, verify each assigned hook and symbol in the live parent. If the assigned decision boundary is absent, report the discrepancy instead of silently substituting another mechanism or adding telemetry around a nearby helper.
lessons.review_rule: Separate controller-rejected allocations from evaluated refutations in the round lesson and preserve the missing coverage as an explicit next-round constraint.

lessons.title: Telemetry activation and a source diff do not prove a power-search effect
lessons.evidence_summary: AES P0 R2-R8 completed 21 official candidates after a promoted leakage-first parent. Fourteen candidates reproduced the parent's 12,026 post-repair-power replacements exactly despite source diffs and, in several cases, nonzero phase telemetry. The remaining alternatives either left power unchanged or regressed leakage.
lessons.planning_rule: While power residual remains active, reserve direct-power exploration for a bounded change to the admitted, ordered, or committed cell set that can expose a different leakage-positive frontier. Do not fill a portfolio with guard, stop, ledger, or telemetry wrappers that merely preserve the inherited selection; at most one such control is justified when it isolates a specific measured failure.
lessons.student_rule: Name the live candidate/admission/ranking/commit decision that changes the actual selected cell set before editing. A trigger-only, environment-only, logging-only, or non-binding tie-break change is incomplete. Preserve legality, electrical, and rollback guards, but make the proposed decision capable of selecting a materially different set.
lessons.review_rule: When official post-repair-power replacements equal the parent, classify the attempt as no_semantic_power_effect even if telemetry fired. Record it as negative exploration evidence and do not rerun a wrapper around the same non-binding decision boundary.

lessons.title: Before power targets are met, timing-only improvements cannot replace the power parent
lessons.evidence_summary: In AES P0 R4-R8, several candidates improved TNS modestly while leakage and dynamic power were unchanged; one R8 candidate improved TNS and dynamic power but increased leakage. The frozen power-first Controller correctly retained the parent because leakage still exceeded its target.
lessons.planning_rule: Keep the Controller's power-first policy intact. During power_reclaim, make the dominant portfolio share direct leakage/dynamic mechanisms; timing guards are safety constraints and must not be presented as sufficient promotion evidence while the power residual is unchanged.
lessons.student_rule: For a power-stage task, report the expected leakage/dynamic mechanism separately from its timing safeguard. Do not claim that a TNS-only improvement completes the assigned power objective.
lessons.review_rule: State whether a non-promoted result failed because power regressed, power was unchanged, or the mechanism did not alter the selected cells; do not collapse these into a generic timing trade-off.
